name: A Ross Story: James
source:
Greetings, I'm the Butler and i will be the narrator of the story. James is a ... special boy. You will see that by yourself during the story,  but be careful,  some goods things  can only happen  when you choose a door. Obviously choose a door close the other you are the one to choose what will happen to him. Hope some magic will help...

[From [url=https://kusersto.itch.io/a-ross-story-james]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你好，我是这部故事的管家兼旁白。James是个……特别的男孩。故事里你会亲自看到这一点。不过要小心，只有选择某扇门，才会发生一些好事。显然，选中一扇门就会关上另一扇；由你决定James将会遭遇什么。希望会有些魔法帮上忙……

[来源：[url=https://kusersto.itch.io/a-ross-story-james]Itch.io[/url]]
